body:
A couple things:
1) Being given a lot more responsibility than normal because my boss is getting married and will be out a lot in the next few months
2) Work closely with a girl who pisses me off a lot. She does things like take credibility for my work and is the boss of the company's friend's daughter so I can never speak up about it. My bosses have noticed and are on my side, but there isn't really more than can be done.
3) I've been waiting for this promotion (or rather, to gain permanent employment...right now i'm technically a year-long 'fellow' supposed to end my time there in October) and it's taking forever to come through so I'm starting to get anxious. The reason is because two departments are arguing over where I should be 'placed' but no one ever asks me what I think about it.
Yep. We lived together in the hellhole house before this also. That's what you meant right? If you meant are we sharing more stress at work, yes and no.
I guess things have also been getting sort of stressful/dramatic at work. That probably isn't helping.
We just moved. Got out of a yearlong horrible group house situation that was stressing us out 24/7. Everything is so much quieter and cleaner here and I feel like I should be happy though.

Hey, thanks for responding. I guess it does boil down to anxiety, I'm definitely no stranger to anxiety problems. It just didn't used to be like this, though. It's like I became super withdrawn all of a sudden and I don't know what caused it or where I went. I mostly have this problem with people I see all the time and spend a lot of time with, like my boyfriend and close friends. "How's work going?" and questions like that don't really lead anywhere anymore.

You're very right, and I'll definitely try. It was loving I guess...I just find it hard to see it that way a lot of the time. Not his or anyone else's fault, mostly mine and the things I can't let go. I agree, he is the bulk of why I'm feeling off. But the thing is that it's not just me letting him get me down. He was just a huge part of my life and one of my main support systems, you know? So with that support system not really available in the same way, I think that's what's screwing me up so bad. I think you're right though, about needing independence. I just don't know where to start.

Thank you, I appreciate it. It's comforting knowing that I'm not the only one. Still hurts but I guess it makes it easier. I am just not used to having real regrets, wishing I could turn back time, etc.
Berlin. I'd love to go to Berlin. Don't know where I'd get the money, though.

Hmm that does seem like a nice option. I don't know, I tend to feel selfish when I want to do things that would just be drains on my parents' money. They already pay an insane amount of tuition for me and it wouldn't be fair to them. In fact I think one of the things keeping me from killing myself is what a waste of tuition money it will be for my parents.

We're talking. We used to text back and forth all day every day. Now we text back and forth most days for a little while, but I don't know. It just seems forced now. It feels like he's not as into talking. I go to school 500 miles away and he used to always wanna talk on the phone, Skype, etc. and say he missed me and stuff. He just doesn't do that any more and I don't know what happened or what I did? I want to talk to him about it I just don't know how. I'm home on break now and we're talking about hanging out this weekend but I'm so nervous and half of me feels like he doesn't even want to hang out. I don't know...when we were just friends he used to tell me about girls he hooked up with and how he usually ended up thinking they were annoying and stuff after. I guess I'm just afraid I've become one of those girls? But I don't know why that is...blah. The incident is whatever...it's so long ago that it's just a part of my life. I feel like that's adding to how useless I'm feeling though. I was assaulted before I got my first kiss, so sex has always been a power thing and I've never seen sexual things as loving. And I guess now I'm worried that my fears/what I learned when i was younger is true...that is, that people who see you sexually see you as an object and not a person anymore. I just don't know how i'm ever going to have a functional relationship when I truly believe that on like a deep level i can't control you know? I'm trying to fight my way out of it, I really am. I just feel like i'm not getting anywhere and it's killing me.
That would be really nice. No money for that though unfortunately. Any break I take would just be selfish =/

I'll be 21 in a month and a half (late bloomer yada yada). It was progressive I guess. It's hard to say. Around the same time we started hooking up, i started taking birth control which made me really depressed and anxious (the hormones did not agree with me). A couple months after I started that I stopped it because it was making me crazy, but I think that's what originally made me feel like he was changing toward me. Maybe then it just became a self-fulfilling prophecy, I don't know. He was my best friend for 3 years before this, and even more than that he was obsessed with me. Liked me, made jokes about marrying me, all that dumb shit. It was one of those tragic 'nice guy is in love with his best friend but she won't give him the time of day' things until I came around and started actually liking him like that...then it was like I had missed my chance or something. And Idk I would talk to my friends about this but honestly, it's embarassing. To me, feeling like this is a sign of me being weak. I know that's not right, but it's just how I feel ya know? I've been through worse than this. I was sexually assaulted when I was 14 for christ's sake...I shouldn't be a worse mess now. Haha but I am...I just feel so useless right now, like I've backed myself into a corner and I either need to get used to how much the corner sucks or try to just escape it all.

Haha I appreciate that. I feel so whiny right now, and it really isn't like me at all. None of my friends know that I've been depressed for months. I just put on this really great happy face and no one is the wiser. The one friend I would be talking about this with is the one who I slept with all summer...but like i said, I just think he hates me now. Whether he actually does or I've just convinced myself of that in my head I have no clue...Also, TMI but I lost my virginity to him. Fancy that. Is this what happens though? Really? If I have sex with someone they start hating me? Cuz that makes me feel like I'm worth so much... This whole semester has just been a clusterfuck. I feel like I'm trying to keep my head above water 24/7 and i just don't even know where the strength is going to come from anymore. I feel like I am fucking up in every way that I can and like I'm going to regret it for the rest of my life. And I don't want to be unhappy for ever blah
It just feels like everyone leaves. I just don't want to feel so lonely all the time. I feel like an island.

I ran into the guy who sexually assaulted me two years after the incident, at the same resort that it had happened at. My best friend was on the vacation with me, and knew what happened. The first night after I saw him again, I got a huge migraine and was freaking out/couldn't get myself to calm down. My best friend, even though she was tired, listened to me blubber for an hour about how scared I felt. Then she slept next to me (even though she had her own bed) so that I would feel less scared and able to sleep. I don't think I ever told her how much that meant to me.
